Victoria]]'s win over [[Platense F.C.]] at [[Estadio Nilmo Edwards]].[http://www.diez.hn/futboldeprimera/864749-99/victoria-abre-el-apertura-2015-con-triunfo-a-costas-del-platense Diez.hn – Victoria abre el Apertura 2015 con triunfo a costas del Platense] – 1 August 2015 [[Juticalpa F.C.]]'s first ever [[Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional de Honduras|Liga Nacional]] game occurred on 9 August with great success for the debs as they managed to beat [[Real C.D. España]] with a 2–0 score. This game also served as the first ever official game at recently opened stadium [[Estadio Juan Ramón Brevé Vargas|Juan Ramón Brevé Vargas]].[http://www.elheraldo.hn/zonadeportiva/867065-331/juticalpa-debuta-ante-el-real-espa%C3%B1a ElHeraldo.hn – Juticalpa tuvo debut soñado ante el Real España] – 9 August 2015 On 30 August, [[C.D.S. Vida]] defeated [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] with a 2–3 away score for the first time after 21 years at [[Estadio Tiburcio Carías Andino]].[http://televicentro.hn/nota/2015/8/30/olimpia-buscar%C3%A1-el-triunfo-n%C3%BAmero-22-ante-el-vida-en-el-nacional Televicentro.hn – Vida acaba con maldición al vencer 3–2 al Olimpia en el Nacional] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150902082801/http://televicentro.hn/nota/2015/8/30/olimpia-buscar%C3%A1-el-triunfo-n%C3%BAmero-22-ante-el-vida-en-el-nacional |date=2015-09-02 }} – 30 August 2015 That Olimpia's defeat represented their first time losing three consecutive games playing in [[Tegucigalpa]] since [[2001–02 Honduran Liga Nacional|2001]] and their worst season start ever with a 1–0–4 record at the moment. On 7 September, Juticalpa's [[Roger Espinoza (coach)|Roger Espinoza]] became the first coach to be sacked due to poor results.[http://www.laprensa.hn/deportes/877341-410/el-juticalpa-fc-decide-separar-a-roger-espinoza LaPrensa.hn – El Juticalpa FC decide separar a Roger Espinoza] – 7 September 2015 On 12 September, Vida's defender [[Elder Torres]] broke an all-time record against [[F.C. Motagua|C.D. Motagua]] for being sent off after only 8 seconds of kickoff in a match played at Tegucigalpa.[http://www.diez.hn/futboldeprimera/879502-99/elder-torres-del-vida-recibe-la-roja-m%C3%A1s-r%C3%A1pida-de-liga-nacional Diez.hn – Elder Torres del Vida recibe la roja más rápida de Liga Nacional] – 12 September 2015 That same night, Olimpia's coach [[Héctor Vargas]] reached his 400 game as a manager in the Honduran Liga Nacional since his debut in [[1997–98 Honduran Liga Nacional|1998]].[http://www.diariomas.hn/2015/09/13/datos-curiosos-y-tabla-de-la-fecha-8-del-torneo-apertura-de-honduras/ DiarioMas.hn – Datos curiosos y tabla de la fecha 8 del torneo Apertura de Honduras] – 13 September 2015 On 26 September, manager [[Ramón Maradiaga]] coached his last game with Vida leading his team in a 2–0 victory over [[C.D. Real Sociedad]] as he was hired by the [[El Salvador national football team]] on their quest to the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]].[http://www.laopinion.com/2015/09/20/el-hondureno-maradiaga-sera-el-nuevo-tecnico-de-el-salvador/ LaOpinion.com – El hondureño Maradiaga será el nuevo técnico de El Salvador] – 20 September 2015 On 4 October, [[Mali]]an defender [[Mamadou Serov Traoré|Mamadou Traoré]] became the first African player to score a goal in the history of the league in the Platense's 2–1 win over Vida.[http://www.diariomas.hn/2015/10/04/datos-curiosos-y-tabla-de-la-fecha-11-del-torneo-apertura-de-honduras/ DiarioMas.hn – Datos curiosos y tabla de la fecha 11 del torneo Apertura de Honduras] – 4 October 2015 On 7 October, Marathón's president [[Yankel Rosenthal]] was arrested in [[Miami]] after the [[United States Department of Justice]] released a statement saying that he, as well as his uncle [[Jaime Rosenthal]] and cousin [[Yani Rosenthal]] were labeled "specially designated narcotics traffickers" under the Kingpin Act.[https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2015/10/07/powerful-honduran-businessman-accused-of-money-laundering usnews.com – Powerful Honduran businessman indicted in US for alleged money laundering for drug traffickers] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151117014433/http://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2015/10/07/powerful-honduran-businessman-accused-of-money-laundering |date=2015-11-17 }} – 7 October 2015 On 6 November, [[C.D. Honduras Progreso]] clinched their first ever regular season title after defeating 1–0 Marathón at [[Estadio Humberto Micheletti]]. On 14 November, Motagua defeated Real España 7–1 at Tegucigalpa setting a record as the largest victory against them;[http://radiohouse.hn/tarde-de-records-en-el-nacional/ RadioHouse.hn – TARDE DE RÉCORDS] – 14 November 2015 representing also, the worst regular season finish for Real España with only 15 points of 54 possible (27.78%). On 10 December, international [[midfielder]] and Olimpia player [[Arnold Peralta]] was shot dead by a gunman in [[La Ceiba]], five days after playing his last game in the semifinals.{{Cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/dec/11/former-rangers-player-arnold-peralta-shot-dead-in-honduras|title = Former Rangers player Arnold Peralta shot dead in Honduras|website = [[TheGuardian.com]]|date = 11 December 2015}} On 19 December, Honduras Progreso lifted their first league title after defeating Motagua on penalty shootouts after a 4–4 aggregate.[http://www.diez.hn/futboldeprimera/motagua/912630-99/honduras-progreso-el-nuevo-rey-de-la-liga-nacional Diez.hn – ¡Honduras Progreso, el nuevo rey de la Liga Nacional!] – 19 December 2015 ===Regular season=== ====Standings==== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |section=Apertura |show_limit=5 |res_col_header=QR |team1=HON|name_HON=[[C.D.
